By.description: How a take was placed on the song's bars.

oneOf.description: The take was played to the song's click: the composition's tempo map is its tempo.
The take's tempo was estimated from its audio.
The owner stated the place and the tempo.

Composition.description:
How a song is written down: the tempo, meter and key maps, the sections, and where each part
sits. Every position is a `bar.beat.tick` [`Position`] on the song's bars, at
`ticks_per_quarter`, written as it falls: `3.4.0` in 3/4 is refused, since that place is
`4.1.0`.

end.description: Where the song ends, when it says; otherwise the latest end of any placement.

key.description:
Key changes in order, the first at `1.1.0`, or none when no key is stated. The key is
information for operations and the score: it changes no note.

meter.description: Meter changes in order, the first at `1.1.0`, each on a bar line.

placements.description: Where each part sits. Several over the same bars are layered.

sections.description:
Named spans in order, each from its `at` to the next section's, the last to the song's
end. Names need not be unique.

tempo.description: Tempo changes in order, the first at `1.1.0`. Each holds until the next.

ticks_per_quarter.description: The resolution tick offsets in positions are counted in.

Key.description: A key such as D minor, Bb major or D dorian, with at most 7 sharps or flats.

KeyAt.description: A key from a place on.

key.description: The key, such as G minor.

MeterAt.description: A meter from a bar line on.

Name.description: A name in the project: lowercase letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens, such as wayfaring or blood-sport-v2.

Placed.description:
Where a take falls on the song's bars: the place on the bars where its own start falls, and
the seconds into the take where that place sounds.

at_secs.description: The seconds into the take at which `bar` falls. At least 0.

bar.description: The place on the song's bars.

bpm.description:
The take's tempo in quarter notes per minute. Present for `estimated` and `set`, absent
for `click`, where the composition's tempo map is the take's tempo.

clock_ppm.description:
How far the take's clock ran from the click's, in parts per million, positive when the
take's ran fast: a moment `t` seconds after `bar` on the click's clock falls
`at_secs + t * (1 + clock_ppm / 1,000,000)` seconds into the take. For `click` only.
Absent means no drift was measured or applied.

Placement.description: Where a part sits on the song's bars.

at.description: The place on the song's bars where the part's own `1.1.0` falls.

from.description:
Where in the part, in its own positions, the stretch that plays starts. Absent is its
start.

part.description: The part, by its stem in the song's `parts/`.

repeat.description: How many times the part plays back to back, for a groove. Absent is once.

to.description: Where in the part, in its own positions, the stretch that plays ends. Absent is its end.

Position.description: A position as bar.beat.tick, such as 3.2.240: bar and beat from 1, the tick an offset into the beat in the part's ticks. bar.beat alone is tick 0.

Section.description: A named span of the song, from its `at` to the next section's.

name.description: The owner's name for it, such as `verse 2`.

Song.description: A song's document: the body of `song` 1.0.

composition.description: How the song is written down: its bars, and where each part sits on them.

id.description:
The song's stable id: a UUIDv7, minted by `duet song new` and never changed. Renaming
the song's folder or its title leaves it.

intent.description: What the song is meant to be, in the owner's words. duet never reads it.

takes.description:
The takes the song links, each by its name and digest, in the order they were linked.
Written always, and read as none when a song written before takes has no such key.

title.description: The song's name for people. Its folder's name is its name for commands.

Status.description:
Where a song stands: a closed state machine, set by the owner or by an agent with the
owner, never inferred (ruling 9).

```text
idea ──▶ sketch ──▶ developing ──▶ arranged
                        ▲              │
                        └── reopen ────┘
```

TakeDigest.description: The SHA-256 of a take's decoded samples: the bytes `duet-take-1`, the rate as a little-endian u32, the channel count as a little-endian u16, then every sample, interleaved, as the little-endian bits of its f32.

TakeLink.description:
A take a song links: the take by its project name and its digest, the parts it is for, and
where it falls on the song's bars once placed.

digest.description: The take's digest: the song finds the take by its audio, whatever it is called.

for.description: The parts the take is for, by name, each once. A part need not be written yet.

placed.description: Where the take falls on the song's bars. Absent when the link is not placed.

take.description: The take's name in the project.

TempoAt.description: A tempo from a place on.

TimeSig.description: A time signature such as 4/4 or 6/8: the denominator is 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.
